readinessQuestions.explanation: Struktur yang benar adalah 'I am entitled to' diikuti oleh kata benda (noun phrase). Pilihan kedua salah karena menggunakan preposisi 'for', dan pilihan ketiga salah secara tata bahasa.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Manakah kalimat yang menunjukkan sikap 'assertive' (tegas namun profesional) saat menyampaikan keluhan, menghindari sikap terlalu pasif atau agresif?
options: You must give me my money back right now or I will report you!
I am entitled to a full refund as the product is defective and still under warranty.
Maybe you could help me get my money back if it's not too much trouble?
readinessQuestions.explanation: Pilihan kedua adalah contoh assertiveness yang tepat karena menyatakan hak secara jelas dan profesional. Pilihan pertama terlalu agresif, sedangkan pilihan ketiga terlalu pasif.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Customer Service: 'We can offer you a store credit for this item.' Respon mana yang paling tepat dan tegas untuk menolak tawaran tersebut dan menuntut pengembalian uang?
options: I don't really care, just give me whatever you want.
You are a terrible company and I hate your store credit!
I insist on a full refund because the product is defective and I have the warranty.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Pilihan ketiga menggunakan frasa 'I insist on' yang menunjukkan ketegasan profesional dalam menuntut hak, sesuai dengan materi pembelajaran.

vocab.meaning: rusak, cacat, tidak berfungsi dengan baik
vocab.collocation: The laptop I purchased is defective and will not turn on despite being fully charged.
As a consumer, I am entitled to a replacement under the two-year manufacturer's warranty.
This product comes with a 12-month warranty that covers all manufacturing defects.
I would like to request a full refund as the item does not match the online description.

vocab.meaning: rusak, bermasalah, tidak bekerja dengan benar
vocab.collocation: The headphones are faulty—the left speaker produces no sound at all.
The product does not match the specifications listed on your website.

vocab.meaning: meningkatkan ke level yang lebih tinggi
vocab.collocation: If this issue is not resolved today, I will need to escalate my complaint to senior management.
I insist on receiving a replacement unit since this one arrived damaged.
Under consumer protection law, I have the right to return faulty goods within 30 days.
I would like to speak with a supervisor as this matter has not been handled appropriately.

dialogue.context: Sarah membawa kembali blender yang rusak ke toko elektronik. Dia berbicara dengan customer service representative untuk meminta pengembalian dana. Blender tersebut masih dalam masa garansi 1 tahun.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Good morning. I purchased this blender three weeks ago, and it's already stopped working. The motor makes a strange noise and then shuts off completely.
lines.translation: Selamat pagi. Saya membeli blender ini tiga minggu yang lalu, dan sudah berhenti bekerja. Motornya mengeluarkan suara aneh lalu mati total.

lines.speaker: Customer Service
lines.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Do you have your receipt and the warranty card with you?
lines.translation: Saya turut prihatin mendengarnya. Apakah Anda membawa struk dan kartu garansi?

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Yes, here they are. The product is clearly defective and does not match the specifications. It should last much longer than three weeks.
lines.translation: Ya, ini dia. Produk ini jelas rusak dan tidak sesuai spesifikasi. Seharusnya bertahan lebih dari tiga minggu.

lines.speaker: Customer Service
lines.text: We can send it for repairs under warranty. It usually takes about two to three weeks.
lines.translation: Kami bisa mengirimkannya untuk perbaikan dengan garansi. Biasanya memakan waktu dua hingga tiga minggu.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: I'm not satisfied with that solution. I am entitled to a full refund or immediate replacement since the product is faulty. I've only used it a few times.
lines.translation: Saya tidak puas dengan solusi itu. Saya berhak mendapat pengembalian dana penuh atau penggantian langsung karena produknya rusak. Saya baru memakainya beberapa kali.

lines.speaker: Customer Service
lines.text: I understand your frustration, but our policy requires repair attempts first before replacement.
lines.translation: Saya memahami kekecewaan Anda, tapi kebijakan kami mengharuskan upaya perbaikan terlebih dahulu sebelum penggantian.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Under consumer protection law, I have the right to choose between repair, replacement, or refund for defective goods. I insist on speaking with a supervisor to resolve this matter today.
lines.translation: Berdasarkan hukum perlindungan konsumen, saya berhak memilih antara perbaikan, penggantian, atau pengembalian dana untuk barang rusak. Saya ingin berbicara dengan supervisor untuk menyelesaikan masalah ini hari ini.

lines.speaker: Customer Service
lines.text: Let me call the store manager for you. Please wait just a moment.
lines.translation: Biar saya panggilkan manajer toko untuk Anda. Mohon tunggu sebentar.

speakingLab.context: Anda berperan sebagai konsumen yang membeli smartphone yang ternyata baterainya cepat habis dan layarnya berkedip-kedip. Anda datang ke service center untuk menuntut penggantian. Mr. Khoirul berperan sebagai customer service representative. Praktikkan cara menyampaikan keluhan secara tegas namun sopan.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Good afternoon! Welcome to TechMart Service Center. How can I assist you today?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Good afternoon. I bought this smartphone from your store two weeks ago, and it has serious problems. The battery drains within three hours, and the screen flickers constantly.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: I see. That does sound problematic. Do you have the purchase receipt and warranty documentation?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, here's everything. The product is clearly defective and does not match the specifications you advertised. I am entitled to a replacement under warranty.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: I understand your concern. However, we typically need to run diagnostics first, which takes 5-7 business days. Then we can determine if it needs repair or replacement.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: That's not acceptable. I've only had this phone for two weeks and it's already faulty. I insist on an immediate replacement. I cannot wait another week without a working phone.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: I apologize for the inconvenience. Let me check our inventory to see if we have the same model available for immediate exchange.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Thank you. If a replacement isn't available today, I would like to escalate this complaint to your supervisor and request a full refund instead.

quiz.question: I am ___ to a full refund because the product is defective and still under warranty.
options: entitled
entitle
entitling
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'entitled' (past participle digunakan sebagai adjective) setelah 'to be' untuk menyatakan 'berhak'. Pola: be + entitled + to + noun. 'I am entitled to a refund' berarti 'Saya berhak mendapat pengembalian dana'.

quiz.question: The laptop I purchased is ___ and will not turn on at all.
options: defective
defect
defectively
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'defective' (adjective) untuk mendeskripsikan produk yang rusak atau cacat. Pola: be + defective. 'Defect' adalah noun (kerusakan), sedangkan 'defectively' adalah adverb. Dalam konteks ini kita butuh adjective untuk melengkapi 'is'.

quiz.question: I must ___ that you process my refund immediately, as I have been waiting for three weeks.
options: insist
insisting
insisted
quiz.explanation: Setelah modal verb 'must', gunakan bare infinitive (verb tanpa 'to'). Pola: must + insist + that-clause. 'I must insist that...' adalah cara formal dan tegas untuk menekankan permintaan Anda sebagai konsumen.

quiz.question: The product does not match the ___ listed on your website.
options: specifications
specify
specified
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'specifications' (plural noun) untuk merujuk pada detail teknis atau spesifikasi produk. Setelah article 'the' kita butuh noun. 'Specify' adalah verb, dan 'specified' adalah past participle yang biasanya digunakan sebagai adjective.

quiz.question: If this issue is not resolved today, I will need to ___ my complaint to senior management.
options: escalate
escalation
escalated
quiz.explanation: Setelah 'need to', gunakan bare infinitive. Pola: need + to + escalate. 'Escalate' (verb) berarti 'meningkatkan ke level lebih tinggi'. 'Escalation' adalah noun, dan 'escalated' adalah past tense/participle.

modules.title: Ujian Kelulusan B1.2: Evaluasi Komprehensif Komunikasi Global & Dunia Kerja
modules.objective: Ujian kelulusan komprehensif 4 keterampilan (Listening, Reading, Writing, Speaking) untuk membuka Sub-Level B1.3

theory.summary: Ujian kelulusan B1.2 ini mengevaluasi kemampuan Anda dalam empat keterampilan utama bahasa Inggris: mendengarkan (Listening), membaca (Reading), menulis dan tata bahasa (Writing & Grammar), serta berbicara (Speaking). Ujian ini dirancang untuk mengukur kemampuan komunikasi Anda dalam konteks global dan dunia kerja, termasuk wawancara kerja, penanganan keluhan, negosiasi bisnis, dan pemahaman hak konsumen. Anda akan menghadapi 16 soal yang terbagi merata dengan fokus pada present perfect continuous untuk aktivitas berkelanjutan, modals of deduction untuk menyimpulkan informasi, passive voice untuk konteks formal, dan used to/be used to untuk kebiasaan. Skor minimal 75% diperlukan untuk melanjutkan ke level B1.3.
rules: Present Perfect Continuous: have/has + been + verb-ing → Digunakan untuk menekankan durasi aktivitas yang dimulai di masa lalu dan masih berlanjut atau baru saja selesai. Contoh: 'I have been working here for three years.' (Saya sudah bekerja di sini selama tiga tahun.)

Modals of Deduction: must/might/can't/could + verb → Digunakan untuk menyimpulkan atau menduga sesuatu berdasarkan bukti. must = sangat yakin (positif), might/could = mungkin, can't = yakin tidak mungkin. Contoh: 'She must be the manager.' (Dia pasti manajernya.) / 'He can't be serious.' (Dia pasti tidak serius.)

Passive Voice: be + past participle → Digunakan ketika fokus pada objek/penerima aksi, bukan pelaku. Sangat umum dalam konteks bisnis dan formal. Contoh: 'The report was submitted yesterday.' (Laporan itu diserahkan kemarin.) / 'Customers are informed about their rights.' (Pelanggan diberi tahu tentang hak mereka.)

Used to vs Be used to: 'used to + infinitive' = kebiasaan masa lalu yang tidak lagi dilakukan. 'be used to + noun/gerund' = terbiasa dengan sesuatu saat ini. Contoh: 'I used to smoke.' (Dulu saya merokok.) vs 'I'm used to working late.' (Saya terbiasa bekerja larut.)

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Umum: Mencampuradukkan Present Perfect Simple dan Continuous
commonTrap.explanation: Siswa sering salah memilih antara present perfect simple dan continuous. Present perfect simple fokus pada hasil atau fakta ('I have finished the report'), sedangkan present perfect continuous menekankan durasi atau proses yang sedang berlangsung ('I have been working on the report for two hours'). Dalam konteks wawancara kerja atau negosiasi, menggunakan continuous menunjukkan komitmen dan proses berkelanjutan.
commonTrap.wrong: I have worked on this project. (Jika ingin menekankan durasi hingga sekarang)
commonTrap.correct: I have been working on this project for six months. (Menekankan durasi dan kontinuitas)

readinessQuestions.prompt: Pilihlah kalimat yang menggunakan Passive Voice dengan benar untuk konteks laporan bisnis.
options: The manager submitted the report yesterday.
The report was submitted by the manager yesterday.
The report has submitting yesterday.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Passive voice dibentuk dengan 'be + past participle'. Kalimat kedua menggunakan 'was submitted' yang tepat untuk menyatakan aksi yang dilakukan pada subjek (laporan), sedangkan pilihan pertama adalah kalimat aktif.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Manakah kalimat yang paling tepat untuk menekankan durasi aktivitas yang masih berlangsung hingga saat ini?
options: I have been working on this project for six months.
I have work on this project for six months.
I have working on this project for six months.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Present perfect continuous (have/has + been + verb-ing) digunakan untuk menekankan durasi aktivitas yang dimulai di masa lalu dan masih berlanjut hingga sekarang, yang sangat penting dalam konteks profesional.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Lengkapi kalimat berikut untuk menyatakan kebiasaan saat ini: 'I have lived in London for five years, so [...] the busy traffic.'
options: I used to deal with
I am used to dealing with
I am use to deal with
readinessQuestions.explanation: 'Be used to + gerund' digunakan untuk menyatakan sesuatu yang sudah menjadi kebiasaan atau hal yang biasa dilakukan saat ini, berbeda dengan 'used to' yang merujuk pada kebiasaan masa lalu.

vocab.collocation: The airline offered compensation for the delayed flight.
We reached an agreement after hours of negotiation.
We'll try to accommodate your special requests.
Please bring your credentials to the interview.
You're entitled to a full refund if the product is defective.
We're looking for proactive team members who take initiative.
I'd like to file a formal complaint about the service.
Can we extend the deadline by one week?
We need to evaluate all candidates before making a decision.
The company accepts no liability for lost items.

dialogue.context: Sarah sedang menghadiri wawancara kerja untuk posisi marketing coordinator di sebuah perusahaan multinasional. Pewawancara, Mr. Thompson, menanyakan pengalaman dan keterampilan Sarah.

lines.speaker: Mr. Thompson
lines.text: Good morning, Sarah. Thank you for coming. Could you tell me about your current role?
lines.translation: Selamat pagi, Sarah. Terima kasih sudah datang. Bisakah Anda ceritakan tentang peran Anda saat ini?

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Good morning. I've been working as a junior marketing specialist for two years now, and I've been managing our social media campaigns.
lines.translation: Selamat pagi. Saya sudah bekerja sebagai spesialis pemasaran junior selama dua tahun sekarang, dan saya sudah mengelola kampanye media sosial kami.

lines.speaker: Mr. Thompson
lines.text: That's interesting. What made you decide to apply for this position?
lines.translation: Itu menarik. Apa yang membuat Anda memutuskan untuk melamar posisi ini?

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: I'm looking for new challenges and your company's international projects really appeal to me. I'm used to working in multicultural teams.
lines.translation: Saya mencari tantangan baru dan proyek internasional perusahaan Anda benar-benar menarik bagi saya. Saya terbiasa bekerja di tim multikultural.

lines.speaker: Mr. Thompson
lines.text: Excellent. Can you describe a situation where you had to handle a difficult client complaint?
lines.translation: Bagus sekali. Bisakah Anda menjelaskan situasi di mana Anda harus menangani keluhan klien yang sulit?

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Certainly. Last month, a client complained about delayed delivery. I listened to their concerns, offered immediate compensation, and ensured the issue was resolved within 24 hours.
lines.translation: Tentu. Bulan lalu, seorang klien mengeluh tentang pengiriman yang tertunda. Saya mendengarkan kekhawatiran mereka, menawarkan kompensasi segera, dan memastikan masalahnya diselesaikan dalam 24 jam.

lines.speaker: Mr. Thompson
lines.text: That shows great initiative. One final question: Where do you see yourself in five years?
lines.translation: Itu menunjukkan inisiatif yang bagus. Satu pertanyaan terakhir: Di mana Anda melihat diri Anda dalam lima tahun?

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: I hope to have developed my skills further and be leading a marketing team, contributing to the company's global expansion.
lines.translation: Saya berharap telah mengembangkan keterampilan saya lebih jauh dan memimpin tim pemasaran, berkontribusi pada ekspansi global perusahaan.

speakingLab.context: Anda berperan sebagai seorang customer service representative di bandara internasional. Mr. Khoirul akan berperan sebagai penumpang yang mengalami masalah dengan penerbangan yang tertunda dan bagasi yang hilang. Tujuan Anda adalah menangani keluhannya dengan profesional, menawarkan solusi, dan memastikan kepuasannya.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excuse me, I need to speak with someone about my flight. It's been delayed for four hours and now they're saying my luggage is missing!

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I'm very sorry to hear about this situation, sir. Let me help you. Could you please provide me with your booking reference number?

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Here it is: BK7492. This is unacceptable! I have an important meeting tomorrow morning and all my documents are in that suitcase.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I completely understand your frustration. Let me check the system right away. While I'm doing that, I can offer you meal vouchers and arrange accommodation for tonight.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Accommodation is fine, but what about my luggage? And will I receive any compensation for this inconvenience?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Your luggage has been located and will be delivered to your hotel by 10 PM tonight. Regarding compensation, you're entitled to €400 for the delay, and we'll process that within 7 business days.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That sounds better. Can you also help me rebook my connecting flight?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Absolutely. I've already arranged you on the first flight tomorrow at 7 AM, and we've upgraded you to business class as a gesture of goodwill. Is there anything else I can assist you with?

quiz.question: [Listening Comprehension] Dengarkan transkrip wawancara kerja berikut: 'Interviewer: How long have you been working in digital marketing? Candidate: I've been working in this field for about five years, but I've been specializing in SEO for the last two years.' Berdasarkan transkrip, berapa lama kandidat tersebut sudah berspesialisasi dalam SEO?
options: Five years
Two years
Seven years
quiz.explanation: Kandidat mengatakan 'I've been specializing in SEO for the last two years', yang berarti dia sudah berspesialisasi dalam SEO selama dua tahun terakhir. Meskipun dia bekerja di bidang digital marketing selama lima tahun, spesialisasi SEO-nya baru dimulai dua tahun lalu.

quiz.question: [Listening Comprehension] Dengarkan transkrip percakapan di bandara berikut: 'Passenger: My flight was delayed by six hours and my luggage is lost. Agent: I sincerely apologize. According to our policy, you're entitled to €600 compensation for delays over four hours. We've also located your luggage and it will be delivered tonight.' Apa yang ditawarkan agen kepada penumpang?
options: €400 compensation and luggage tracking
€600 compensation and luggage delivery tonight
Free flight upgrade and hotel accommodation
quiz.explanation: Agen dengan jelas menyebutkan dua hal: kompensasi €600 untuk keterlambatan lebih dari empat jam, dan pengiriman bagasi malam itu juga. Ini adalah solusi konkret yang ditawarkan untuk menangani keluhan penumpang.

quiz.question: [Listening Comprehension] Dengarkan transkrip berikut: 'Manager: I must say, you've been performing exceptionally well. Employee: Thank you. I've been trying to improve my skills. Manager: It shows. You must be very dedicated to your work.' Apa kesimpulan yang dibuat manajer tentang karyawan tersebut?
options: The employee might be looking for a new job
The employee must be very dedicated
The employee can't be working hard enough
quiz.answer: The employee must be very dedicated
quiz.explanation: Manajer menggunakan modal 'must be' untuk menyatakan kesimpulan yang sangat yakin berdasarkan bukti (performa luar biasa karyawan). 'Must' dalam konteks deduction menunjukkan kepastian tinggi bahwa karyawan tersebut sangat berdedikasi pada pekerjaannya.

quiz.question: [Listening Comprehension] Dengarkan transkrip resolusi komplain berikut: 'Customer: I ordered this product three weeks ago and it still hasn't arrived. Representative: I apologize for the inconvenience. Your order was delayed due to customs clearance, but it has been dispatched and should arrive by Friday. We'll also refund your shipping costs.' Apa penyebab keterlambatan pesanan?
options: The product was out of stock
There were customs clearance issues
The shipping address was incorrect
quiz.explanation: Representatif dengan jelas menyatakan bahwa 'Your order was delayed due to customs clearance', yang berarti keterlambatan disebabkan oleh proses bea cukai. Ini adalah penjelasan spesifik tentang akar masalah keterlambatan.

quiz.question: [Reading Comprehension] Bacalah teks berikut: 'In today's global marketplace, companies must be proactive in addressing customer complaints. Research shows that 70% of customers who have their complaints resolved quickly remain loyal to the brand. Effective complaint handling involves listening carefully, offering immediate solutions, and following up to ensure satisfaction.' Menurut teks, berapa persen pelanggan yang tetap setia jika keluhan mereka diselesaikan dengan cepat?
quiz.explanation: Teks secara eksplisit menyatakan 'Research shows that 70% of customers who have their complaints resolved quickly remain loyal to the brand.' Ini adalah statistik penting yang menunjukkan dampak penanganan keluhan yang efektif terhadap loyalitas pelanggan.

quiz.question: [Reading Comprehension] Bacalah artikel tentang hak konsumen berikut: 'Under EU regulations, airline passengers are entitled to compensation when flights are delayed by more than three hours. The amount varies: €250 for flights under 1,500 km, €400 for EU flights over 1,500 km, and €600 for international flights over 3,500 km. However, compensation is not required if the delay was caused by extraordinary circumstances beyond the airline's control.' Berapa kompensasi untuk penerbangan EU sejauh 2,000 km yang tertunda 4 jam?
quiz.explanation: Penerbangan EU sejauh 2,000 km (lebih dari 1,500 km) yang tertunda lebih dari 3 jam berhak mendapat kompensasi €400 sesuai dengan regulasi yang disebutkan dalam teks. Kategori €600 hanya untuk penerbangan internasional lebih dari 3,500 km.

quiz.question: [Reading Comprehension] Bacalah teks bisnis berikut: 'The new marketing strategy has been implemented across all departments. Sales reports are now generated automatically and sent to managers weekly. Customer feedback is being collected through multiple channels and analyzed to improve our services. These changes have resulted in a 25% increase in customer satisfaction.' Bagaimana laporan penjualan sekarang dibuat dan dikirimkan?
options: They are created manually by sales staff monthly
They are generated automatically and sent weekly
They must be requested by managers individually
quiz.answer: They are generated automatically and sent weekly
quiz.explanation: Teks dengan jelas menyatakan dalam passive voice: 'Sales reports are now generated automatically and sent to managers weekly.' Ini menunjukkan sistem otomatis yang berjalan setiap minggu untuk menghasilkan dan mengirimkan laporan.

quiz.question: [Reading Comprehension] Bacalah teks berikut tentang adaptasi kerja: 'Many professionals find it challenging to adjust when they start working remotely. However, after a few weeks, most employees become used to the flexibility and report higher productivity. Companies that used to require daily office attendance are now embracing hybrid work models.' Apa yang dialami sebagian besar karyawan setelah beberapa minggu bekerja remote?
options: They remain uncomfortable with remote work
They become used to the flexibility
They request to return to the office
quiz.answer: They become used to the flexibility
quiz.explanation: Teks menyatakan 'most employees become used to the flexibility', yang berarti sebagian besar karyawan menjadi terbiasa dengan fleksibilitas kerja remote. Frasa 'become used to' menunjukkan proses adaptasi yang berhasil setelah periode penyesuaian.

quiz.question: [Writing & Grammar] Pilih kalimat yang menggunakan present perfect continuous dengan benar untuk menunjukkan aktivitas berkelanjutan dalam konteks wawancara kerja:
options: I work on international projects for three years now.
I have been working on international projects for three years.
I am working on international projects for three years.
quiz.answer: I have been working on international projects for three years.
quiz.explanation: Present perfect continuous (have been working) adalah struktur yang tepat untuk menekankan durasi aktivitas yang dimulai di masa lalu dan masih berlanjut hingga sekarang. Struktur ini sering digunakan dalam wawancara kerja untuk menunjukkan pengalaman berkelanjutan. 'For three years' menunjukkan durasi waktu.

quiz.question: [Writing & Grammar] Pilih kalimat yang menggunakan modal of deduction dengan tepat untuk menyimpulkan situasi berdasarkan bukti:
options: She might be the new manager because she's very confident.
She must be the new manager because I saw her name on the door.
She can be the new manager if she wants to.
quiz.answer: She must be the new manager because I saw her name on the door.
quiz.explanation: Modal 'must' digunakan untuk deduction dengan tingkat kepastian tinggi berdasarkan bukti konkret (nama di pintu). 'Might' menunjukkan kemungkinan yang lebih rendah, sedangkan 'can' dalam konteks ini tidak tepat untuk menyimpulkan fakta. Bukti visual yang jelas memerlukan 'must' untuk menunjukkan kesimpulan yang hampir pasti.

quiz.question: [Writing & Grammar] Ubah kalimat aktif berikut ke dalam passive voice yang tepat untuk konteks formal bisnis: 'The company will announce the new policy next week.' Manakah bentuk passive yang benar?
options: The new policy will announce by the company next week.
The new policy will be announced next week.
The new policy is announced by the company next week.
quiz.answer: The new policy will be announced next week.
quiz.explanation: Passive voice yang benar untuk future simple adalah 'will be + past participle'. Struktur 'will be announced' adalah bentuk pasif yang tepat dan natural dalam konteks formal bisnis. Menyebutkan 'by the company' tidak perlu karena sudah jelas dari konteks, dan passive voice sering digunakan untuk fokus pada objek (kebijakan) bukan pelaku (perusahaan).

quiz.question: [Writing & Grammar] Pilih kalimat yang menggunakan 'used to' dan 'be used to' dengan benar:
options: I used to working in a corporate office, but now I'm used to work from home.
I used to work in a corporate office, but now I'm used to working from home.
I use to work in a corporate office, but now I used to working from home.
quiz.answer: I used to work in a corporate office, but now I'm used to working from home.
quiz.explanation: Struktur yang benar: 'used to + infinitive' untuk kebiasaan masa lalu yang tidak lagi dilakukan (used to work), dan 'be used to + gerund' untuk sesuatu yang sudah menjadi kebiasaan saat ini (used to working). Perbedaan ini penting: yang pertama tentang masa lalu, yang kedua tentang kenyamanan saat ini.

quiz.question: [Speaking & Situational Dialogue] Seorang klien mengeluh tentang layanan yang buruk. Respons mana yang paling profesional dan sesuai untuk customer service representative?
options: That's not our fault. You should have read the terms and conditions.
I sincerely apologize for the inconvenience. Let me see how I can resolve this for you immediately.
Many customers complain about this. There's nothing we can do.
quiz.answer: I sincerely apologize for the inconvenience. Let me see how I can resolve this for you immediately.
quiz.explanation: Respons ini menunjukkan empati profesional dengan meminta maaf secara tulus, mengakui masalah tanpa menyalahkan pelanggan, dan langsung menawarkan tindakan konkret untuk menyelesaikan masalah. Ini adalah standar emas dalam customer service: acknowledge, apologize, act.

quiz.question: [Speaking & Situational Dialogue] Dalam wawancara kerja, pewawancara bertanya: 'What are your salary expectations?' Respons mana yang paling diplomatis dan profesional?
options: I expect at least $100,000 or I'm not interested.

I'm flexible and open to discussion. Based on my research and experience, I believe a range of $70,000-$85,000 would be appropriate, but I'm interested in hearing what you typically offer for this role.
I don't know. How much are you willing to pay?
quiz.answer: I'm flexible and open to discussion. Based on my research and experience, I believe a range of $70,000-$85,000 would be appropriate, but I'm interested in hearing what you typically offer for this role.
quiz.explanation: Respons ini menunjukkan profesionalisme dengan: (1) menunjukkan fleksibilitas, (2) memberikan range berdasarkan riset dan pengalaman, (3) membuka ruang negosiasi dengan bertanya tentang standar perusahaan. Ini adalah keseimbangan antara menghargai diri sendiri dan bersikap terbuka dalam negosiasi.

quiz.question: [Speaking & Situational Dialogue] Saat bernegosiasi deadline proyek dengan klien, manakah respons yang paling efektif untuk meminta perpanjangan waktu?
options: I can't finish by Friday. Give me more time.
I understand the urgency, but to ensure the highest quality output, would it be possible to extend the deadline to Monday? This would allow me to thoroughly review all aspects.
The deadline is impossible. Everyone knows that.
quiz.answer: I understand the urgency, but to ensure the highest quality output, would it be possible to extend the deadline to Monday? This would allow me to thoroughly review all aspects.
quiz.explanation: Respons ini efektif karena: (1) mengakui kebutuhan klien dengan 'I understand the urgency', (2) memberikan alasan yang berorientasi pada manfaat (kualitas tinggi), (3) menawarkan alternatif spesifik (Monday), dan (4) menjelaskan nilai tambah dari perpanjangan. Ini adalah negosiasi yang konstruktif, bukan penolakan atau keluhan.

quiz.question: [Speaking & Situational Dialogue] Ketika seorang kolega menawarkan bantuan untuk proyek Anda, respons mana yang paling sopan dan profesional?
options: No, I don't need your help. I can handle it myself.
That's very kind of you, thank you. I'm actually working on the budget section right now. If you could review the market analysis part, that would be extremely helpful.
Whatever. Do what you want.
quiz.answer: That's very kind of you, thank you. I'm actually working on the budget section right now. If you could review the market analysis part, that would be extremely helpful.
quiz.explanation: Respons ini menunjukkan profesionalisme dan kolaborasi yang baik dengan: (1) mengucapkan terima kasih atas tawaran, (2) memberikan konteks tentang apa yang sedang dikerjakan, (3) memberikan tugas spesifik yang jelas, dan (4) menyatakan apresiasi. Ini membangun kerja tim yang efektif dan saling menghormati.

modules.title: Media Literacy: Detecting Biases, Fact-Checking & Spotting Misinformation
modules.group: B1.3 - Critical Perspectives & Bridge to B2
modules.objective: Menganalisis artikel berita digital, membedakan fakta objektif dari opini, dan mengidentifikasi judul umpan klik (clickbait).

theory.summary: Di era digital, kita dihadapkan dengan ribuan artikel berita setiap hari. Tidak semua informasi yang kita baca akurat atau objektif. Media literacy adalah kemampuan penting untuk mengevaluasi sumber informasi, membedakan fakta dari opini, dan mengenali teknik manipulatif seperti clickbait. Clickbait adalah judul sensasional yang dirancang untuk menarik klik tanpa memberikan substansi. Bias adalah kecenderungan untuk menyajikan informasi dari sudut pandang tertentu. Fact-checking melibatkan verifikasi klaim dengan sumber kredibel dan independen. Sebagai pembaca kritis level B1, Anda perlu mengenali kata-kata emotif, klaim yang tidak didukung bukti, dan sumber yang tidak dapat diverifikasi.
rules: Fakta vs Opini: Fakta dapat diverifikasi dan objektif (contoh: 'The study was published in 2025'), sedangkan opini adalah pandangan subjektif (contoh: 'This is the best solution'). Gunakan frasa seperti 'According to the report...' untuk fakta dan 'In my opinion...' untuk opini.

Clickbait Headlines: Judul clickbait menggunakan kata-kata sensasional, pertanyaan dramatis, atau janji yang berlebihan. Contoh clickbait: 'You Won't Believe What Happened Next!' vs judul objektif: 'New Policy Announced by Government'. Hindari judul dengan 'shocking', 'unbelievable', atau angka yang tidak masuk akal.

Evaluating Sources: Sumber kredibel memiliki penulis yang jelas, tanggal publikasi, dan referensi yang dapat diverifikasi. Gunakan frasa evaluatif: 'This claim is unsubstantiated' (klaim ini tidak berdasar), 'According to independent audits...' (menurut audit independen), 'The evidence suggests...' (bukti menunjukkan).

commonTrap.trapTitle: Peringatan Kesalahan Umum
commonTrap.explanation: Banyak siswa B1 keliru menggunakan frasa evaluatif atau tidak membedakan antara sumber primer dan sekunder. Kesalahan umum adalah menerima informasi tanpa memeriksa kredibilitas sumber.
commonTrap.wrong: This article says it's true, so it must be a fact.
commonTrap.correct: According to independent fact-checkers, this claim requires further verification before it can be considered factual.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Dalam media literacy, penting untuk membedakan fakta dari opini. Manakah kalimat bahasa Inggris berikut yang menggunakan frasa evaluatif dengan benar untuk menyampaikan fakta berdasarkan sumber yang dapat diverifikasi?
options: According to the report published by WHO in 2024, the infection rate decreased by 15%.
I personally believe the infection rate decreased by 15%, and everyone should agree.
The infection rate obviously decreased because the government did an amazing job.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Pilihan pertama benar karena menggunakan frasa evaluatif 'According to the report...' yang merujuk pada sumber spesifik dan dapat diverifikasi (WHO, 2024), sesuai dengan cara menyampaikan fakta secara objektif. Pilihan kedua menggunakan 'I personally believe' yang menunjukkan opini subjektif, bukan fakta. Pilihan ketiga menggunakan kata emotif 'obviously' dan 'amazing' yang menunjukkan bias, bukan penyajian fakta objektif.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Kesalahan umum siswa B1 adalah langsung mempercayai informasi tanpa memeriksa kredibilitas sumber. Manakah respons yang paling tepat ketika seseorang membagikan artikel dengan klaim yang belum terverifikasi?
options: This article says it's true, so it must be a fact and we should share it immediately.
According to independent fact-checkers, this claim requires further verification before it can be considered factual.
The headline sounds shocking, so the information is probably correct and reliable.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Pilihan kedua benar karena menunjukkan sikap kritis dengan merujuk pada fact-checker independen dan menyatakan bahwa klaim memerlukan verifikasi lebih lanjut sebelum dianggap faktual. Pilihan pertama adalah contoh kesalahan umum — langsung menerima informasi sebagai fakta hanya karena tertulis di artikel. Pilihan ketiga juga keliru karena menganggap judul yang sensasional sebagai tanda kebenaran, padahal justru itu ciri khas clickbait.

readinessQuestions.prompt:
Perhatikan percakapan berikut antara Sarah dan Tom tentang sebuah artikel online. Isilah bagian [...] dengan respons yang paling tepat dan natural.

Sarah: "Tom, have you seen this article? The headline says 'Scientists HATE this one simple cure!' It sounds suspicious."
Tom: "[...]"
options: That's a classic example of clickbait. The headline uses sensationalism to attract clicks. We should check if there are any credible sources backing this claim.
Wow, scientists really hate it? That means the cure must be very effective! Let's share it with everyone right away.
I don't care about headlines. All news articles are always completely accurate and trustworthy anyway.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Pilihan pertama adalah respons yang paling tepat karena Tom mengenali judul tersebut sebagai clickbait, mengidentifikasi penggunaan sensasionalisme, dan menyarankan untuk memeriksa sumber kredibel — sesuai dengan prinsip media literacy yang diajarkan dalam modul. Pilihan kedua menunjukkan sikap tidak kritis yang langsung mempercayai judul sensasional. Pilihan ketiga juga keliru karena mengasumsikan semua berita selalu akurat, yang bertentangan dengan prinsip berpikir kritis.

vocab.meaning: penyajian informasi secara berlebihan untuk menarik perhatian
vocab.collocation: The newspaper was criticized for its sensationalism in reporting the incident.
We need to find credible sources to support our research.
Independent fact-checking organizations verified the politician's claims.

vocab.meaning: kecenderungan atau prasangka terhadap sudut pandang tertentu
vocab.collocation: The article shows clear bias towards one political party.
The headline was misleading and didn't reflect the actual content.
This claim is unsubstantiated and lacks supporting evidence.

vocab.meaning: konten dengan judul sensasional untuk menarik klik
vocab.collocation: That website is full of clickbait articles with exaggerated headlines.

vocab.meaning: kecenderungan mencari informasi yang mengkonfirmasi keyakinan kita
vocab.collocation: Confirmation bias makes us ignore evidence that contradicts our beliefs.
Always verify information from multiple sources before sharing it.
Good journalism should present objective facts without personal opinions.

dialogue.context: Sarah dan Tom, dua mahasiswa jurnalistik, sedang mendiskusikan artikel berita yang mereka temukan di media sosial tentang tren kesehatan baru.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Tom, have you seen this article? The headline says 'This ONE weird trick will change your life forever!' Sounds too good to be true.
lines.translation: Tom, kamu sudah lihat artikel ini? Judulnya bilang 'SATU trik aneh ini akan mengubah hidupmu selamanya!' Kedengarannya terlalu bagus untuk jadi kenyataan.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: That's a classic example of clickbait, Sarah. The headline uses sensationalism to get clicks, but I bet the actual content doesn't deliver on that promise.
lines.translation: Itu contoh klasik clickbait, Sarah. Judulnya menggunakan sensasionalisme untuk mendapat klik, tapi aku yakin konten sebenarnya tidak memenuhi janji itu.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: You're right. I checked the source, and it's from an unknown website with no credible references. This claim is completely unsubstantiated.
lines.translation: Kamu benar. Aku cek sumbernya, dan itu dari website tidak dikenal tanpa referensi kredibel. Klaim ini benar-benar tidak berdasar.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Exactly. We need to practice fact-checking before believing everything we read online. Did you find any independent audits or scientific studies backing this up?
lines.translation: Tepat sekali. Kita perlu mempraktikkan fact-checking sebelum percaya semua yang kita baca online. Apakah kamu menemukan audit independen atau studi ilmiah yang mendukung ini?

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Not at all. According to medical experts I consulted, there's no evidence supporting these claims. The article mixes facts with opinions without clearly distinguishing them.
lines.translation: Sama sekali tidak. Menurut ahli medis yang aku konsultasikan, tidak ada bukti yang mendukung klaim ini. Artikel ini mencampur fakta dengan opini tanpa membedakannya dengan jelas.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: That's a red flag. Good journalism should present objective information and clearly label opinions. This is misleading and potentially harmful.
lines.translation: Itu tanda bahaya. Jurnalisme yang baik harus menyajikan informasi objektif dan memberi label jelas pada opini. Ini menyesatkan dan berpotensi berbahaya.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: I agree. We should always verify information from multiple credible sources before sharing it. Our responsibility as future journalists is to combat misinformation.
lines.translation: Aku setuju. Kita harus selalu memverifikasi informasi dari beberapa sumber kredibel sebelum membagikannya. Tanggung jawab kita sebagai jurnalis masa depan adalah melawan misinformasi.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Absolutely. Let's write an article about how to spot clickbait and avoid confirmation bias when reading news online.
lines.translation: Tentu saja. Mari kita tulis artikel tentang cara mengenali clickbait dan menghindari confirmation bias saat membaca berita online.

speakingLab.context: Anda sedang berdiskusi dengan Mr. Khoirul tentang artikel berita kontroversial yang Anda temukan di media sosial. Mr. Khoirul akan membantu Anda menganalisis kredibilitas artikel tersebut dan mengidentifikasi tanda-tanda clickbait atau bias.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! I see you've brought an article to discuss today. What's the headline, and what made you want to analyze it?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Hi Mr. Khoirul! The headline says 'Scientists SHOCKED by this discovery!' I'm suspicious because it seems very sensational.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Good instinct! That's a classic clickbait pattern. Can you tell me who published this article? Is the source credible?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Well, it's from a website I've never heard of before. There's no author name listed, and I can't find any references to scientific journals.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent observation! Those are major red flags. What about the content itself - does it present objective facts or mostly opinions?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Now that you mention it, the article mixes some scientific terms with emotional language like 'absolutely amazing' and 'you won't believe this.' This claim seems unsubstantiated.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Perfect analysis! You've identified sensationalism, lack of credible sources, and unverified claims. What would you do before sharing this article?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I would fact-check it by looking for the same information from independent, credible sources like scientific journals or reputable news organizations before believing or sharing it.

quiz.question: Which of the following is an example of a clickbait headline?
options: Government Announces New Education Policy for 2027
You Won't BELIEVE What This Teacher Did! Number 7 Will SHOCK You!
According to recent studies, screen time affects children's development
quiz.answer: You Won't BELIEVE What This Teacher Did! Number 7 Will SHOCK You!
quiz.explanation: Jawaban yang benar adalah 'You Won't BELIEVE What This Teacher Did! Number 7 Will SHOCK You!' karena menggunakan huruf kapital berlebihan, kata-kata sensasional (BELIEVE, SHOCK), dan janji yang tidak jelas untuk menarik klik. Ini adalah ciri khas clickbait yang memanipulasi rasa ingin tahu tanpa memberikan informasi substantif di judulnya.

quiz.question: The article states: 'According to independent audits, the company's financial reports show irregularities.' This sentence is an example of ___.
options: an objective fact with verifiable source
a personal opinion without evidence
clickbait sensationalism
quiz.answer: an objective fact with verifiable source
quiz.explanation: Jawaban yang benar adalah 'an objective fact with verifiable source' karena kalimat tersebut menggunakan frasa 'According to independent audits' yang menunjukkan sumber kredibel dan dapat diverifikasi. Informasi ini bersifat objektif karena merujuk pada audit independen, bukan opini pribadi, dan dapat dicek kebenarannya.

quiz.question: Which statement best describes confirmation bias?
options: The tendency to verify all information before believing it
The tendency to seek information that confirms our existing beliefs
The practice of checking multiple sources for accuracy
quiz.answer: The tendency to seek information that confirms our existing beliefs
quiz.explanation: Jawaban yang benar adalah 'The tendency to seek information that confirms our existing beliefs' karena confirmation bias adalah kecenderungan psikologis untuk mencari, menafsirkan, dan mengingat informasi yang mengkonfirmasi keyakinan kita yang sudah ada, sambil mengabaikan atau meremehkan bukti yang bertentangan. Ini adalah bias kognitif yang dapat menghambat pemikiran kritis.

quiz.question: A credible news source should have: clear authorship, publication date, and ___.
options: sensational headlines to attract readers
verifiable references and citations
emotional language to engage the audience
quiz.explanation: Jawaban yang benar adalah 'verifiable references and citations' karena sumber berita yang kredibel harus menyediakan referensi yang dapat diverifikasi sehingga pembaca dapat memeriksa keakuratan informasi. Judul sensasional dan bahasa emosional justru merupakan tanda-tanda sumber yang kurang kredibel yang mencoba memanipulasi pembaca.

quiz.question: Choose the correct evaluative phrase to express doubt about an unverified claim:
options: This is definitely true and proven.
This claim is unsubstantiated and requires verification.
Everyone agrees this is the best solution.
quiz.answer: This claim is unsubstantiated and requires verification.
quiz.explanation: Jawaban yang benar adalah 'This claim is unsubstantiated and requires verification.' karena frasa ini tepat digunakan untuk mengekspresikan keraguan terhadap klaim yang belum diverifikasi secara akademis dan profesional. Kata 'unsubstantiated' berarti tidak berdasar atau tidak didukung bukti, dan 'requires verification' menunjukkan sikap kritis yang meminta pemeriksaan lebih lanjut sebelum menerima klaim tersebut sebagai fakta.

modules.title: Third Conditional: Imagining Alternative Past Outcomes, Lessons & Regrets
modules.group: B1.3 - Critical Perspectives & Bridge to B2
modules.objective: Menguasai pengandaian masa lalu yang tidak mungkin terulang kembali menggunakan pola If + had + V3, would have + V3.

theory.summary: Third Conditional digunakan untuk membayangkan hasil yang berbeda dari situasi masa lalu yang sudah tidak mungkin diubah. Struktur ini berguna saat kita ingin mengungkapkan penyesalan, pelajaran hidup, atau menganalisis 'apa yang seharusnya terjadi jika...'. Berbeda dengan Second Conditional yang membicarakan situasi hipotetis saat ini, Third Conditional fokus pada masa lalu yang sudah terlanjur terjadi.
rules: Pola dasar: If + Subject + had + V3 (Past Participle), Subject + would have + V3. Contoh: If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.
Klausa 'if' menggunakan Past Perfect (had + V3) untuk menunjukkan kondisi masa lalu yang tidak terpenuhi. Klausa hasil menggunakan would/could/might + have + V3.
Urutan klausa bisa dibalik: She would have arrived on time if she had left earlier. Jika klausa 'if' di tengah, tidak perlu koma.
Kontraksi alami dalam percakapan: would've = would have, could've = could have, should've = should have, hadn't = had not. Contoh: If you'd called me, I would've helped you.
Gunakan 'could have' untuk kemungkinan atau kemampuan masa lalu: If he had trained more, he could have won the competition. Gunakan 'might have' untuk kemungkinan yang lebih rendah.

commonTrap.trapTitle: Jebakan: Mencampur Tenses dengan Second Conditional
commonTrap.explanation: Kesalahan umum adalah menggunakan 'would' di klausa 'if' atau mencampur struktur dengan Second Conditional. Ingat: klausa 'if' HARUS menggunakan 'had + V3', bukan 'would have'.
commonTrap.wrong: If I would have known about the meeting, I would have attended it.
commonTrap.correct: If I had known about the meeting, I would have attended it.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Manakah kalimat yang secara tata bahasa benar untuk menyatakan pengandaian masa lalu (Third Conditional)?
options: If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.
If I would have studied harder, I had passed the exam.
If I studied harder, I would have passed the exam.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Third Conditional menggunakan pola 'If + had + V3' di klausa syarat dan 'would have + V3' di klausa hasil untuk membayangkan masa lalu yang tidak bisa diubah.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Pilih kalimat yang tepat untuk menghindari kesalahan umum (common trap) dalam penggunaan Third Conditional.
options: If she would have arrived earlier, she would have seen the performance.
If she had arrived earlier, she would have seen the performance.
If she had arrived earlier, she would see the performance.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Kesalahan umum adalah menggunakan 'would' di dalam klausa 'if'. Klausa 'if' harus menggunakan 'had + V3' (Past Perfect) untuk kondisi masa lalu.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan berikut: 'I failed the driving test yesterday.' 'Oh no. If you [...] more, you might have passed.'
options: had practiced
would have practiced
practiced
readinessQuestions.explanation: Dalam Third Conditional, klausa 'if' harus menggunakan Past Perfect (had + V3) untuk menunjukkan kondisi masa lalu yang tidak terpenuhi.

vocab.collocation: I deeply regret not taking that job opportunity when I had the chance.
If we had planned better, the outcome of the project would have been different.
We should have considered alternative solutions before making that decision.
If she had thought about the consequences, she wouldn't have quit her job.
He would have seized that opportunity if he had been more confident.
If I hadn't made that mistake, everything would have turned out perfectly.
If they had prepared more carefully, they could have avoided those problems.
She could have achieved her dreams if she hadn't given up so easily.
If we had acted sooner, we might have prevented the accident.
If I had realized how important it was, I would have done things differently.

dialogue.context: Sarah dan Tom sedang membicarakan keputusan karir Sarah yang tidak jadi pindah ke luar negeri tahun lalu. Mereka merefleksikan apa yang mungkin terjadi jika Sarah mengambil keputusan berbeda.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: You know, I sometimes wonder what would've happened if I had accepted that job offer in Singapore last year.
lines.translation: Kamu tahu, aku kadang bertanya-tanya apa yang akan terjadi kalau aku menerima tawaran pekerjaan di Singapura tahun lalu.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Yeah, I remember that. If you had taken it, you would have been earning twice your current salary by now.
lines.translation: Ya, aku ingat itu. Kalau kamu mengambilnya, kamu sudah akan mendapat gaji dua kali lipat dari sekarang.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: True, but I wouldn't have met my current boyfriend if I had moved abroad. That's something I don't regret.
lines.translation: Benar, tapi aku tidak akan bertemu pacar sekarang kalau aku pindah ke luar negeri. Itu hal yang tidak aku sesali.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: That's a good point. Plus, if you hadn't stayed here, you might not have gotten the promotion last month.
lines.translation: Itu poin yang bagus. Lagipula, kalau kamu tidak tinggal di sini, kamu mungkin tidak akan mendapat promosi bulan lalu.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Exactly! If I had left, someone else would have taken my position. Everything happens for a reason.
lines.translation: Tepat sekali! Kalau aku pergi, orang lain akan mengambil posisiku. Semuanya terjadi karena suatu alasan.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: I agree. Still, if you'd prepared a pros and cons list back then, the decision might have been easier.
lines.translation: Aku setuju. Namun, kalau kamu membuat daftar untung rugi waktu itu, keputusannya mungkin lebih mudah.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: You're right. If I had analyzed it more carefully, I wouldn't have stressed so much about it.
lines.translation: Kamu benar. Kalau aku menganalisisnya lebih hati-hati, aku tidak akan stres sebegitu tentang hal itu.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Well, what's done is done. But hey, if things hadn't worked out this way, we wouldn't be having coffee together right now!
lines.translation: Yah, yang sudah terjadi ya sudah. Tapi hei, kalau semuanya tidak berjalan seperti ini, kita tidak akan sedang ngopi bersama sekarang!

speakingLab.context: Anda akan berdiskusi dengan Mr. Khoirul tentang penyesalan dan pelajaran hidup dari masa lalu. Mr. Khoirul akan menanyakan pengalaman Anda, dan Anda akan berlatih menggunakan Third Conditional untuk mengekspresikan situasi alternatif yang mungkin terjadi.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! Today we're going to reflect on past decisions. Tell me, is there a decision from your past that you sometimes think about differently now?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, I think about the time when I didn't study abroad during university. If I had applied for that exchange program, I would have experienced living in another country.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Interesting! So you regret not applying? What stopped you at that time?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I was worried about the costs. If I had known there were scholarships available, I could have applied for financial support.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: I see. But surely there were some positive outcomes from staying, right? What would you have missed if you had gone abroad?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: That's true. If I had left, I wouldn't have met some of my closest friends here. I also wouldn't have had the internship that led to my current job.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent reflection! So what's the main lesson you learned from this experience?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I learned that if I had done more research back then, I would have made a more informed decision. But I also learned that every choice leads to different opportunities, and we can't predict everything.

quiz.question: If she ___ the alarm clock last night, she wouldn't have overslept this morning.
options: had set
has set
would set
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'had set' (Past Perfect) di klausa 'if' untuk Third Conditional. Ini menunjukkan kondisi masa lalu yang tidak terpenuhi (dia tidak memasang alarm). Pola: If + had + V3, would have + V3.

quiz.question: They would have won the competition if they ___ more effectively as a team.
options: had worked
worked
would work
quiz.explanation: Klausa 'if' dalam Third Conditional memerlukan Past Perfect (had + V3). 'Had worked' menunjukkan bahwa mereka tidak bekerja secara efektif di masa lalu, dan itu mempengaruhi hasil kompetisi.

quiz.question: If I ___ about the traffic jam, I ___ an earlier train.
options: had known / would have taken
knew / would take
have known / will take
quiz.explanation: Kedua bagian kalimat harus mengikuti struktur Third Conditional: If + had + V3 (had known), would have + V3 (would have taken). Ini mengungkapkan penyesalan tentang masa lalu yang tidak bisa diubah.

quiz.question: She ___ her phone if she had been more careful with her belongings.
options: wouldn't have lost
won't lose
didn't lose
quiz.explanation: Klausa hasil dalam Third Conditional menggunakan 'would(n't) have + V3'. Bentuk negatif 'wouldn't have lost' menunjukkan hasil yang berbeda jika kondisi masa lalu terpenuhi (kalau dia lebih hati-hati).

quiz.question: If we ___ the instructions carefully, we ___ so many mistakes in the project.
options: had read / wouldn't have made
read / won't make
would read / hadn't made
quiz.explanation: Pola lengkap Third Conditional: If + had + V3, would(n't) have + V3. 'Had read' di klausa 'if' dan 'wouldn't have made' di klausa hasil menunjukkan analisis kesalahan masa lalu dan hasil alternatif yang mungkin terjadi.

modules.title: Environmental Sustainability: Renewable Energy, Eco-Innovations & Community Actions
modules.group: B1.3 - Critical Perspectives & Bridge to B2
modules.objective: Mendiskusikan solusi perubahan iklim, energi terbarukan, jejak karbon, dan inisiatif ramah lingkungan perkotaan.

theory.summary: Modul ini membekali Anda dengan kosakata dan struktur bahasa untuk membahas isu lingkungan kontemporer. Anda akan belajar menggunakan modal verbs (should, must, could) untuk menyampaikan tanggung jawab dan saran, passive voice untuk menjelaskan proses lingkungan, serta discourse markers (however, therefore, moreover) untuk membangun argumen yang koheren. Di level B1.3, Anda diharapkan mampu mengekspresikan pendapat tentang tanggung jawab perusahaan vs individu dalam pelestarian lingkungan dengan kosakata spesifik seperti carbon footprint, renewable energy, dan zero-waste lifestyle.
rules: Modal verbs untuk tanggung jawab lingkungan: 'We should reduce our carbon footprint' (saran), 'Companies must invest in renewable energy' (kewajiban kuat), 'Communities could implement zero-waste programs' (kemungkinan). Gunakan should untuk rekomendasi umum, must untuk urgensi, could untuk alternatif.

Passive voice untuk proses dan solusi: 'Solar panels are installed on rooftops' (fokus pada aksi), 'Biodegradable packaging is being developed by scientists' (proses sedang berlangsung). Formula: be + past participle. Gunakan struktur ini saat pelaku aksi tidak penting atau tidak diketahui.

Discourse markers untuk argumentasi: 'However, individual actions alone are insufficient' (kontras), 'Therefore, systemic changes are necessary' (kesimpulan), 'Moreover, governments should provide incentives' (penambahan). Tempatkan di awal kalimat diikuti koma untuk transisi yang smooth antar ide.

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Penggunaan Should vs Must
commonTrap.explanation: Siswa sering menggunakan 'must' untuk semua situasi padahal should lebih tepat untuk saran yang tidak wajib. Must mengindikasikan kewajiban keras atau urgensi tinggi, sedangkan should untuk rekomendasi yang masuk akal namun tidak mutlak.
commonTrap.wrong: Individuals must recycle their plastics every day or they are bad people.
commonTrap.correct: Individuals should recycle their plastics to reduce waste, and governments must provide proper recycling infrastructure.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Pilih kalimat yang menggunakan passive voice dengan benar untuk menjelaskan proses lingkungan.
options: Solar panels are installed on rooftops to generate clean electricity.
Scientists are install solar panels on rooftops to generate clean electricity.
Solar panels installed on rooftops by the workers yesterday.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Opsi pertama menggunakan struktur passive voice yang benar (be + past participle: 'are installed'). Opsi kedua salah karena menggunakan 'are install' (seharusnya 'are installing' untuk active voice), dan opsi ketiga adalah kalimat rumpang karena tidak memiliki auxiliary verb 'were'.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Manakah kalimat yang paling tepat menggunakan 'should' untuk saran dan 'must' untuk kewajiban atau urgensi?
options: Governments must reduce emissions, and citizens should try to recycle more.
Citizens must recycle every single item, or they should be fined by the government.
Governments should reduce emissions, but citizens must try to recycle more.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Penggunaan 'must' tepat untuk tindakan pemerintah yang bersifat mendesak/wajib, sedangkan 'should' tepat untuk saran atau rekomendasi bagi individu. Opsi lain salah karena menukar tingkat urgensi atau menggunakan modal yang tidak sesuai konteks.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan berikut dengan kata transisi (discourse marker) yang tepat: "Individual actions are helpful for the planet. [...], they are not enough to solve the climate crisis on their own."
options: However, they are not enough to solve the climate crisis on their own.
Therefore, they are not enough to solve the climate crisis on their own.
Moreover, they are not enough to solve the climate crisis on their own.
readinessQuestions.explanation: 'However' adalah discourse marker yang tepat untuk menunjukkan kontras antara kalimat pertama (tindakan individu membantu) dan kalimat kedua (tindakan individu tidak cukup). 'Therefore' dan 'Moreover' tidak logis dalam konteks pertentangan ide ini.

vocab.meaning: jejak karbon (total emisi gas rumah kaca yang dihasilkan)
vocab.collocation: We need to calculate our carbon footprint before making sustainable changes to our lifestyle.

vocab.meaning: energi terbarukan (sumber energi yang tidak habis)
vocab.collocation: The government plans to invest heavily in renewable energy sources like wind and solar power.
Adopting a zero-waste lifestyle means refusing single-use plastics and composting organic waste.

vocab.meaning: panel surya fotovoltaik (teknologi konversi sinar matahari jadi listrik)
vocab.collocation: Installing solar photovoltaic panels on our roof reduced our electricity bills by 60 percent.

vocab.meaning: kemasan yang dapat terurai secara alami
vocab.collocation: Many restaurants are switching to biodegradable packaging made from plant-based materials.

vocab.meaning: penghijauan kembali (penanaman pohon di area gundul)
vocab.collocation: The reforestation project aims to plant one million trees in deforested areas by 2030.
Effective climate mitigation requires both reducing emissions and developing carbon capture technology.
Cities should promote sustainable transport options like electric buses and bike-sharing programs.

vocab.meaning: inovasi ramah lingkungan (teknologi atau produk baru yang berkelanjutan)
vocab.collocation: This startup specializes in eco-innovation, creating cleaning products from natural ingredients.
The neighborhood launched a community initiative to establish a local composting facility.

dialogue.context: Sarah dan Marco sedang menghadiri workshop lingkungan di kampus mereka. Mereka berdiskusi tentang tanggung jawab individu versus perusahaan dalam mengatasi perubahan iklim setelah presentasi tentang jejak karbon.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: That presentation really opened my eyes. I had no idea my carbon footprint was so large!
lines.translation: Presentasi itu benar-benar membuka mataku. Aku tidak tahu jejak karbonku sebesar itu!

lines.speaker: Marco
lines.text: I know, right? But honestly, I think corporations should bear most of the responsibility, not individuals.
lines.translation: Aku tahu, kan? Tapi sejujurnya, menurutku perusahaan seharusnya menanggung sebagian besar tanggung jawab, bukan individu.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: I partly agree, however, individual actions like adopting a zero-waste lifestyle can create collective impact.
lines.translation: Aku setuju sebagian, namun, tindakan individu seperti menerapkan gaya hidup tanpa sampah bisa menciptakan dampak kolektif.

lines.speaker: Marco
lines.text: True, but without systemic change, it's just a drop in the ocean. Companies must invest in renewable energy sources.
lines.translation: Benar, tapi tanpa perubahan sistemik, itu hanya setetes di lautan. Perusahaan harus berinvestasi di sumber energi terbarukan.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Absolutely. Moreover, governments should provide incentives for businesses that switch to solar photovoltaic systems.
lines.translation: Tentu saja. Terlebih lagi, pemerintah seharusnya memberikan insentif untuk bisnis yang beralih ke sistem panel surya fotovoltaik.

lines.speaker: Marco
lines.text: Exactly! And biodegradable packaging should be mandatory for all food companies. It's not that expensive anymore.
lines.translation: Tepat sekali! Dan kemasan yang dapat terurai alami seharusnya wajib untuk semua perusahaan makanan. Harganya tidak semahal itu lagi.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: I'm joining the campus community initiative next month. We're organizing a reforestation project. Want to come?
lines.translation: Aku akan bergabung dengan inisiatif komunitas kampus bulan depan. Kami sedang mengorganisir proyek penghijauan. Mau ikut?

lines.speaker: Marco
lines.text: Definitely! That sounds like a practical way to contribute. Count me in!
lines.translation: Pasti! Kedengarannya seperti cara praktis untuk berkontribusi. Hitung aku masuk!

speakingLab.context: Anda sedang berdiskusi dengan Mr. Khoirul tentang rencana kampanye lingkungan di komunitas Anda. Mr. Khoirul akan membantu Anda mengembangkan ide dan memberikan saran tentang cara mengkomunikasikan pesan lingkungan secara efektif menggunakan struktur B1.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! I heard you're planning an environmental campaign in your community. That's wonderful! What specific issue would you like to focus on?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Hi Mr. Khoirul! I want to focus on reducing plastic waste because I see too much single-use plastic in my neighborhood.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent choice! Plastic waste is a critical issue. Now, think about this: should individuals change their behavior, or must businesses provide better alternatives? How would you argue this?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I believe both should work together. Individuals should reduce plastic use, however, businesses must offer biodegradable packaging options.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Great use of 'should' and 'must'! And I like your discourse marker 'however'. Can you suggest one practical community initiative to start this campaign?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: We could organize a zero-waste workshop where people learn to make reusable bags and containers from old materials.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Perfect! That's actionable and educational. Now, how would you convince local shop owners to participate? Try using 'moreover' to add another reason.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I would say that reducing plastic saves them money on packaging costs. Moreover, it will attract environmentally conscious customers to their stores.

quiz.question: Companies ___ invest in renewable energy to reduce their environmental impact significantly.
options: should
must
could
quiz.explanation: Jawaban 'must' benar karena konteks menunjukkan kewajiban kuat dan urgensi untuk perusahaan berinvestasi dalam energi terbarukan demi dampak signifikan. 'Should' terlalu lemah untuk menekankan pentingnya aksi ini, sedangkan 'could' hanya menunjukkan kemungkinan tanpa kewajiban.

quiz.question: Solar photovoltaic panels ___ on thousands of rooftops across the city last year.
options: installed
are installed
were installed
quiz.explanation: Jawaban 'were installed' benar karena menggunakan passive voice dalam past tense. Kalimat fokus pada panel yang dipasang (bukan siapa yang memasang), dan 'last year' menunjukkan waktu lampau, sehingga 'were' (past tense dari 'be') + past participle 'installed' adalah struktur yang tepat.

quiz.question: Individual actions are important. ___, systemic changes from governments are essential for real progress.
options: Therefore
However
Moreover
quiz.explanation: Jawaban 'However' benar karena menunjukkan kontras antara dua ide: pentingnya aksi individu vs pentingnya perubahan sistemik. 'Therefore' salah karena menunjukkan kesimpulan, sedangkan 'Moreover' salah karena menambahkan informasi yang sejalan, bukan mengontraskan.

quiz.question: Which statement best describes a zero-waste lifestyle?
options: Buying products with minimal packaging and composting organic waste
Using plastic bags but recycling them every week
Purchasing new eco-friendly products frequently
quiz.answer: Buying products with minimal packaging and composting organic waste
quiz.explanation: Pilihan pertama benar karena zero-waste lifestyle fokus pada mengurangi sampah dari awal (minimal packaging) dan mengelola limbah organik (composting). Opsi kedua masih menggunakan plastik sekali pakai, dan opsi ketiga bertentangan dengan prinsip zero-waste karena mendorong konsumsi berlebihan meskipun produknya 'ramah lingkungan'.

quiz.question: The local community ___ a reforestation project to plant 5,000 trees in the deforested area next month.
options: is launching
launched
has launched
quiz.explanation: Jawaban 'is launching' benar karena menggunakan present continuous untuk rencana masa depan yang sudah pasti ('next month'). 'Launched' salah karena menunjukkan past tense sedangkan aksinya belum terjadi. 'Has launched' salah karena present perfect menunjukkan aksi yang sudah selesai dengan relevansi ke sekarang, bukan rencana mendatang.

modules.title: Advanced Reported Speech: Nuanced Reporting Verbs
modules.group: B1.3 - Critical Perspectives & Bridge to B2
modules.objective: Menggantikan 'say' dan 'tell' dengan kata kerja pelapor presisi seperti admit, warn, advise, remind, apologize, dan refuse.

theory.summary: Dalam reported speech tingkat lanjut, kita menggunakan reporting verbs yang lebih spesifik untuk menyampaikan nuansa dan maksud pembicara dengan lebih akurat. Alih-alih hanya menggunakan 'say' atau 'tell', kita bisa menggunakan kata kerja seperti admit (mengakui), warn (memperingatkan), advise (menasihati), remind (mengingatkan), apologize (meminta maaf), refuse (menolak), offer (menawarkan), dan promise (berjanji). Setiap reporting verb memiliki pola gramatikal tersendiri yang harus diikuti.
rules: Verb + to-infinitive: Digunakan dengan kata kerja seperti offer, promise, refuse, threaten, agree. Contoh: He offered to help me. | She refused to answer the question. | They agreed to meet at 5 PM.

Verb + object + to-infinitive: Digunakan dengan kata kerja seperti warn, advise, remind, encourage, persuade, invite. Contoh: He warned us not to go there. | She advised me to study harder. | They reminded him to lock the door.

Verb + -ing / preposition + -ing: Digunakan dengan kata kerja seperti admit, deny, suggest, apologize for, insist on, accuse of. Contoh: He admitted making a mistake. | She apologized for being late. | They denied stealing the money. | He insisted on paying for dinner.

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Umum: Menggunakan Pola 'That-clause' untuk Semua Reporting Verbs
commonTrap.explanation: Banyak siswa salah menggunakan pola 'that-clause' untuk semua reporting verbs karena terbiasa dengan 'say that' atau 'tell that'. Padahal, setiap reporting verb memiliki pola gramatikal khusus yang berbeda. Misalnya, 'advise' tidak diikuti langsung dengan 'that-clause' tanpa objek.
commonTrap.wrong: She advised that I should study harder. (kurang natural) | He apologized that he was late. (salah)
commonTrap.correct: She advised me to study harder. | He apologized for being late.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Manakah kalimat yang menggunakan pola reporting verb dengan benar?
options: He refused to help me with the project.
He refused helping me with the project.
He refused that he helped me with the project.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Kata kerja 'refuse' harus diikuti oleh pola to-infinitive (to + verb), bukan bentuk -ing atau that-clause.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Manakah kalimat yang paling tepat untuk melaporkan permintaan maaf seseorang?
options: She apologized that she was late.
She apologized for being late.
She apologized to be late.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Kata kerja 'apologize' memerlukan preposisi 'for' diikuti oleh bentuk -ing (gerund), bukan that-clause atau to-infinitive.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Lengkapi kalimat berikut berdasarkan konteks percakapan: "The manager was very strict. He [...] us not to miss any more deadlines."
options: admitted
offered
warned
readinessQuestions.explanation: Pola 'warn + object + not + to-infinitive' adalah struktur yang tepat untuk menyampaikan peringatan tentang bahaya atau konsekuensi.

vocab.meaning: mengakui (sesuatu yang tidak menyenangkan atau memalukan)
vocab.collocation: He admitted making a serious mistake in the report.
The teacher warned us not to copy answers during the exam.
The doctor advised him to get more rest and exercise regularly.
She reminded me to send the email before the deadline.
He apologized for interrupting the meeting without permission.
She refused to sign the contract until she read all the terms.
My neighbour offered to help me carry the heavy boxes upstairs.
They promised to arrive on time for the important presentation.
The suspect denied stealing money from the office safe.
My grandmother insisted on paying for everyone's dinner at the restaurant.

dialogue.context: Sarah dan Tom sedang membicarakan pertemuan tim yang baru saja selesai, di mana beberapa anggota tim membuat komitmen dan pernyataan penting.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Did you hear what Mark said in the meeting? He admitted making that accounting error last month.
lines.translation: Kamu dengar apa yang Mark katakan di rapat? Dia mengakui membuat kesalahan akuntansi bulan lalu.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Yes, I was surprised. At least he was honest about it. But did you notice that Jenny refused to take responsibility for the late delivery?
lines.translation: Ya, saya terkejut. Setidaknya dia jujur tentang itu. Tapi apakah kamu perhatikan bahwa Jenny menolak bertanggung jawab atas keterlambatan pengiriman?

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: I did. She denied having anything to do with it, even though we all saw the emails. Anyway, the manager warned us not to miss any more deadlines.
lines.translation: Saya perhatikan. Dia menyangkal punya hubungan dengan itu, meskipun kita semua melihat email-emailnya. Bagaimanapun, manajer memperingatkan kita untuk tidak melewatkan tenggat waktu lagi.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: That's true. He also advised us to improve our communication between departments. I think he's right about that.
lines.translation: Benar. Dia juga menasihati kita untuk meningkatkan komunikasi antar departemen. Saya pikir dia benar tentang itu.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Definitely. Oh, and David offered to train the new staff members next week. That was kind of him.
lines.translation: Pasti. Oh, dan David menawarkan untuk melatih anggota staf baru minggu depan. Itu baik darinya.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Yes, and he promised to finish the training manual by Friday. I hope he keeps his word this time.
lines.translation: Ya, dan dia berjanji menyelesaikan manual pelatihan pada hari Jumat. Saya harap dia menepati janjinya kali ini.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Me too. Before the meeting ended, the manager reminded everyone to submit their reports by Wednesday.
lines.translation: Saya juga. Sebelum rapat berakhir, manajer mengingatkan semua orang untuk menyerahkan laporan mereka pada hari Rabu.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Good thing he did. I almost forgot about that. By the way, Lisa apologized for being late to the meeting. She said her train was delayed.
lines.translation: Untung dia melakukannya. Saya hampir lupa tentang itu. Oh ya, Lisa meminta maaf karena terlambat ke rapat. Dia bilang keretanya tertunda.

speakingLab.context: Anda sedang berlatih dengan Mr. Khoirul untuk menggunakan reporting verbs dalam situasi sehari-hari. Mr. Khoirul akan memberikan situasi, dan Anda harus merespons dengan kalimat reported speech yang tepat.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! Today we'll practice advanced reporting verbs. Let me give you a situation: Your friend said, 'I'm sorry I forgot your birthday.' How would you report this using an appropriate reporting verb?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: My friend apologized for forgetting my birthday.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent! Perfect use of 'apologize for + -ing'. Now, imagine your boss said to you, 'Don't share confidential information with anyone.' How would you report this?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: My boss warned me not to share confidential information with anyone.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Very good! You used the pattern 'warn + object + not to-infinitive' correctly. Here's another one: Your colleague said, 'I'll help you with the presentation tomorrow.' What reporting verb fits best here?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: My colleague offered to help me with the presentation tomorrow.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Perfect! Now try this challenging one: Your teacher said to the class, 'You should review your notes every day.' How would you report this with a more precise verb than 'said'?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Our teacher advised us to review our notes every day.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Outstanding work! You've mastered the key patterns. Remember, choosing the right reporting verb makes your English much more precise and natural. Keep practicing these structures!

quiz.question: The manager ___ us not to leave confidential documents on our desks overnight.
options: warned
offered
promised
quiz.explanation: Jawaban yang benar adalah 'warned'. Kata kerja 'warn' digunakan untuk memperingatkan seseorang tentang bahaya atau hal yang tidak boleh dilakukan. Polanya adalah 'warn + object + (not) to-infinitive'. Dalam konteks ini, manajer memperingatkan tentang tidak meninggalkan dokumen rahasia.

quiz.question: Sarah ___ for arriving late to the interview because of heavy traffic.
options: admitted
apologized
denied
quiz.explanation: Jawaban yang benar adalah 'apologized'. Kata kerja 'apologize' digunakan untuk meminta maaf, dengan pola 'apologize for + -ing'. Sarah meminta maaf karena terlambat, bukan mengakui (admit) atau menyangkal (deny).

quiz.question: The doctor ___ him to reduce his sugar intake and exercise more regularly.
options: reminded
advised
refused
quiz.explanation: Jawaban yang benar adalah 'advised'. Kata kerja 'advise' digunakan untuk memberi nasihat atau saran, dengan pola 'advise + object + to-infinitive'. Dokter memberikan saran kesehatan, bukan mengingatkan (remind) atau menolak (refuse).

quiz.question: The suspect ___ stealing the money from the cash register despite the video evidence.
options: refused
denied
warned
quiz.explanation: Jawaban yang benar adalah 'denied'. Kata kerja 'deny' digunakan untuk menyangkal atau menolak mengakui sesuatu, dengan pola 'deny + -ing'. Tersangka menyangkal mencuri, meskipun ada bukti. 'Refuse' akan diikuti 'to-infinitive', bukan '-ing'.

quiz.question: My colleague ___ to give me a ride to the airport early in the morning.
options: insisted
offered
admitted
quiz.explanation: Jawaban yang benar adalah 'offered'. Kata kerja 'offer' digunakan untuk menawarkan bantuan atau sesuatu secara sukarela, dengan pola 'offer + to-infinitive'. Rekan kerja menawarkan untuk mengantar. 'Insist' memerlukan preposisi 'on' dan '-ing', sedangkan 'admit' tidak cocok dengan konteks menawarkan bantuan.

modules.title: Habit Science & Productivity: Goal-Setting Psychology & Overcoming Procrastination
modules.group: B1.3 - Critical Perspectives & Bridge to B2
modules.objective: Membahas psikologi pembentukan kebiasaan, manajemen waktu, fokus kerja, dan strategi mengatasi penundaan tugas.

theory.summary: Psikologi produktivitas menjelaskan bagaimana otak kita membentuk kebiasaan melalui dopamine reward loop—sebuah siklus yang dimulai dengan cue (pemicu), craving (keinginan), response (respons), dan reward (hadiah). Ketika kita menunda tugas (procrastination), otak mencari kepuasan instan. Strategi mengatasi ini termasuk time-blocking (mengatur waktu khusus untuk tugas tertentu), breaking goals into manageable chunks (memecah tujuan besar menjadi bagian kecil), dan deep work (fokus tanpa gangguan). Accountability partner (teman yang membantu kita tetap bertanggung jawab) juga efektif untuk menjaga konsistensi.
rules: Present Simple untuk kebiasaan rutin: 'I tend to put off tasks whenever I feel overwhelmed.' (Formula: Subject + tend to + verb + whenever/when + condition)
Present Continuous untuk tindakan saat ini: 'I'm breaking milestones into manageable chunks this month.' (Formula: Subject + am/is/are + verb-ing + time expression)
